issues.description: Method Milkable.messageOnMilk: the problem statement (UML and textual description) and the template Main expect a no-argument method messageOnMilk() returning a String (the spec: "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). In the solution repository, the Milkable interface declares messageOnMilk(double volume) (a single double parameter) and Seal/Goat implement that parameterized signature. This parameter-list mismatch between the specified API and the solution will cause compilation or test failures and confuses students which contract to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent across all artifacts. Preferred: change the solution so Milkable declares String messageOnMilk() (no parameters) and update Seal.java and Goat.java to implement messageOnMilk() returning the format "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" to match the problem statement and template Main. Alternatively, if a volume parameter is desired educationally, update the problem statement UML/text and the template Main to require messageOnMilk(double volume) and document the expected return format, then keep the solution as-is. Ensure all three artifacts (problem statement, template, solution) use the same signature.
